reachabilityTitle: Reachability mode (default): shows only tech your project can actually unlock, by scanning set_technology across focuses, events, and decisions {clause}. Click to switch to Hide hidden.
reachabilityClauseNone: (no set_technology yet — using a best-guess filter)
hideHiddenTitle: Hide hidden mode: hides vanilla tech that's switched off (allow = always_no) by spotting the tell-tale signs — no prerequisites, no references, no categories, imported. Click to switch to Show all.
showAllTitle: Show all mode (edit mode): filters only foreign tech, for copying or reskinning vanilla hidden tech (sturmtruppe → USA_assault, etc.). Click to switch to Reachability.
autoLayoutTitle: Auto-layout by category: same category goes in the same column, and overlapping nodes get fixed.
collisionTitle: Overlapping nodes detected. Try clicking Auto-layout.
emptyLineHint: Add a technology to this line, or double-click the canvas to place one at a specific year.
emptyHeroTitle: This tech line is still empty
emptyHeroDesc: Tech pacing sets your world's tempo — start with this line's first entry
autoLayoutConfirmTitle: Auto-layout will overwrite the imported original layout
autoLayoutConfirmBody: {moved} technologies in this line will move, {imported} of which were imported from a mod and still carry the original author's layout. Continuing overwrites them with computed columns and marks those {imported} as edited by you, so exports will use the new layout. The original layout cannot be restored automatically.
layoutModeTitle: Unlock the research-board slots for deliberate placement. Normal browsing never moves a technology.
layoutModeDoneTitle: Finish arranging and return to the locked research board.
